description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView component for displaying log messages within an Android application. It implements the LogNode interface to output formatted log data, including handling different log levels, exceptions, and chaining with other LogNode instances.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A customized TextView that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface, formatting log messages and handling UI updates.

methods.description: Constructor initializing LogView with a context.

methods.description: Constructor initializing LogView with a context and attribute set.

methods.name: LogView(Context, AttributeSet, int)
methods.description: Constructor initializing LogView with a context, attribute set, and style.

methods.name: println(int, String, String, Throwable)
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message; delegates to next LogNode if chained.

methods.name: getNext()
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog(String)
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView display.
